mapper.select: SELECT id, name, start_date, end_date, is_current, create_time FROM semester ORDER BY is_current DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO semester (name, start_date, end_date, is_current) VALUES (#{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, IFNULL(#{isCurrent}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE semester SET is_current = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
